intro.text: A member of the Cett family who owns and runs Ashweather Carriage and Coach in Elendel.

items.text: When Wax came to Ashweather asking who had hired a carriage on the night of a murder, Cett was so keen to help that Wax grew suspicious, and the records pointed him to coach sixteen. Cett knew nothing about Bleeder, but Wax worked out that he paid a Rioter to stir up business, which the Allomantic Agreement of '94 forbids, and said he would report it to the constable-general.

appearance.text: Pudgy, in a formal suit with a waistcoat and long tails.

personality.text: Above all he wants to make money. He is more deferential to nobility than to ordinary people, and will bend or break the law to help his business.
